newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oriental Land to debut on TSE 1st section - paper.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Land to debut on TSE 1st section - paper.

text.p: Shares of Oriental Land Co Ltd, the operator of Tokyo Disneyland, will be listed directly on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) in early December, a Japanese newspaper said.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun economic daily said on Sunday that Oriental Land's share listing on the TSE first section will become possible following deregulation at the exchange.
Oriental Land's shares are not publicly traded now.

Under current TSE rules, shares are usually initially listed on the second section, the paper said. A company must have more than 600 million shares and more than 40,000 shareholders to directly list its shares on the TSE first section without first listing them on the second section, the paper said.
The TSE is planning to change the rules so that a company with more than 100 million shares outstanding can directly list on the first section.
Oriental Land has already issued a little more than 83 million shares and plans to issue about an additional 17 million shares at the time of the listing, the paper said.
Officials at the TSE and Oriental Land were not immediately available for comment.
